name: Ulybka Chjornoj Koshki
source: Events of this story cover the time period from 6th November, 2022 to 2nd June, 2039. Generally events occur in the real world - what occurred after the incident beginning (the government too wasn't idle) and about what players, being in game, couldn't know. And also what happened to some heroes, the Aincrad creation purposes, and what was occur after. Doesn't retell an original plot (events go parallelly).
translation: 这个故事的事件覆盖了2022年11月6日至2039年6月2日的时间段。事件主要发生在现实世界——事件开始后发生了什么（政府也没有闲着），以及玩家们在游戏中无法知道的事情。还包括一些英雄们的遭遇、艾恩葛朗特的建造目的以及之后发生的事。不重述原作剧情（事件是平行展开的）。
